label: Assist
desc: AI finds and surfaces relevant information. Human does all analysis and decides.
example: AI retrieves relevant regulation; analyst reads and interprets

label: Augment
desc: AI drafts, summarises, and recommends. Human reviews, edits, and decides.
example: AI drafts RCSA risk assessment; risk officer approves or modifies

label: Automate
desc: AI performs defined tasks end-to-end within controlled scope. Human handles exceptions.
example: AI extracts and validates data; human reviews exceptions above threshold

label: Orchestrate
desc: AI coordinates multiple systems and agents across a multi-step workflow.
example: AI agent manages RCSA end-to-end; human approves at defined gates

label: Bounded autonomy
desc: AI acts within explicit boundaries; humans set scope, rules, and review material exceptions.
humanRole: Rule design, exception review, and continuous governance
example: AI monitors controls and self-remediates defined exception types
